heading: Mumbai police register FIR after 21-year-old nanny finds her explicit photos posted on Instagram
author: Times News Network /  Sep 21, 2026, 21:32 IST
paragraphs: Mumbai: A 21-year-old woman, working as a nanny, has lodged a police complaint after her explicit images were uploaded on Instagram by a user not known to her
When she messaged him on the platform to remove her photos, he demanded money from her
Amboli police have registered an FIR and are probing further.The complainant lives in Jogeshwari
She had given her fiancé access to her Instagram account
On Sept 19, her fiancé called her up and enquired if she knew an Instagram user who had posted her explicit photos online
She logged into her account and found a “follow request” from a user she did not know
When she checked his profile, she found three photos of hers
Of these, two photos were explicit and included a private photo of her and her fiancé
Their faces in the images had been covered with emojis
When she sent a direct message to the user and asked him to delete the pictures, he demanded a sum of Rs 10,000 from her
